data.current_description:
Manage IP whitelist for enterprise security.

**Actions:**
- `add` - Add IP to whitelist (requires email verification)
- `remove` - Remove IP from whitelist
- `list` - List all whitelisted IPs
data.summary_suggestion: Manage enterprise IP whitelist access control
data.description_suggestion: Manages enterprise IP whitelist for access control. Accepts an action parameter to perform one of three operations: (1) `add` - adds an IP address to the whitelist with email verification requirement, (2) `remove` - removes an IP address from the whitelist, or (3) `list` - retrieves all currently whitelisted IP addresses. Returns the updated whitelist state or list of IPs depending on the action performed. Requires authentication.
